assembly: concatenate edges, lanes, connections and junctions of the chunks in part order; all indices (edges[].lanes, lanes[].edge/junction, connections[]) are global indices into the concatenated arrays

provenance.source: SUMO network of this run (sumolib, internal lanes included)
provenance.domain: lanes with a point or segment in |x|, |y| <= 4000 m, kept whole (not clipped at the boundary); internal lanes of connections between kept lanes; pedestrian-, bicycle- and rail-only lanes dropped; lanes closed to passenger cars carry allow (e.g. 'bus')
provenance.elevation: z = terrain street surface DemSurface.road(x, y) (DEM with open water and foreshore filled from the banks). OSM bridges (bridge=* or layer>0 from the scene OSM subset, matched to lanes by the lane origId OSM way ids and by projection onto the way) get a deck of max(layer, 1) x 6.5 m (city model DECK_M) above the straight line between the street heights at the ends of the bridge run, rising from the run ends at 0.06 m/m; junctions whose incident lanes all end on a bridge are raised by the lowest level and runs there do not ramp. Tunnels and covered ways are flagged in edges[].structure and kept on the street surface (depth unknown). Shapes resampled every 10 m for terrain and simplified in 3D at 0.1 m; coordinates rounded to 0.1 m.
provenance.internal_lanes: lanes[].edge is null and lanes[].junction indexes junctions[]
